description: This file is a Perl script named checkpatch.pl used for checking code patches and source files, particularly in the context of Linux kernel development and OpenWrt projects. It includes functions for parsing diffs, patches, and source code, and runs various code style and correctness checks.

methods.name: list_types
methods.description: Lists all message types recognized by the checkpatch script.

methods.name: top_of_openwrt_tree
methods.description: Checks if the current directory is at the top level of an OpenWrt source tree.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main function for processing each input file or patch, performing various code checks.

methods.name: read_words
methods.description: Reads and tokenizes words from external files or configuration.

methods.name: seed_camelcase_file
methods.description: Seeds the list of camel case words from the current file.

methods.name: is_maintained_obsolete
methods.description: Checks if the current file is maintained or obsolete.
